# enstow

> A secret-aware dotfile manager combining GNU stow symlinking with seamless sops and age decryption.

enstow manages modular dotfile packages across platforms with native symlink tracking and in-memory decryption for secret files (e.g., .age and .sops.yaml). Plaintext secret targets are written with strict permissions (0600) without ever storing plaintext secrets in version control.

## Documentation

- [Project README](README.md): Comprehensive user guide covering features, installation, commands, examples, environment variables, configuration, and hooks.
- [Man Page](assets/enstow.1): UNIX roff manual page documenting CLI arguments, subcommands, options, and behaviors.
- [Configuration Example](assets/config.example.toml): Fully commented template demonstrating options for source, target, packages, profiles, keys, permissions, lifecycle hooks, and ignore rules.

## Core Modules

- [CLI Definition](src/cli.rs): Clap-based CLI structure, command routing, subcommands, arguments, and dynamic shell completions.
- [Stow Engine](src/stow.rs): Dotfile scanning, file action planning, symlink creation, collision handling, backups, adopt mode, and status auditing.
- [Cryptographic Engine](src/crypto.rs): Secret detection, in-memory age and sops decryption, secure file creation (0600), encryption, interactive editing, and rekeying.
- [Diff Engine](src/diff.rs): Unified diff generation between dotfiles and destination targets with secret masking support.
- [Lifecycle Hooks](src/hook.rs): Pre- and post-apply and unstow lifecycle hook execution with contextual environment variables.
- [Configuration Engine](src/config.rs): Hierarchical configuration parser for TOML, YAML, and JSON with profile and hook support.
- [Error Types](src/error.rs): Custom domain error definitions covering I/O, encryption, decryption, symlink, hook, and configuration failures.
- [Library Root](src/lib.rs): Public module declarations and API surface.
- [Main Entry](src/main.rs): Main executable entry point with tracing initialization, configuration merging, and subcommand dispatch.

## CLI Commands

- [Add](README.md#ingesting-dotfiles-enstow-add): Ingest an existing machine dotfile into a package as a symlink or encrypted secret.
- [Apply](README.md#applying-dotfiles): Symlink regular dotfiles and decrypt secret files into target directories.
- [Restow](README.md#restowing-packages): Re-apply dotfiles, pruning stale links and re-decrypting modified secrets.
- [Unstow](README.md#unstowing-dotfiles): Cleanly remove symlinks and decrypted secret target files with optional secure shredding (--shred).
- [Scrub](README.md#unstowing-dotfiles): Securely zeroize and delete decrypted secret files and symlinks.
- [Status](README.md#inspecting-status): Inspect sync, missing, conflict, modified drift, and unverified states with optional JSON output.
- [Diff](README.md#commands): Show unified diff between package dotfiles and target destination with optional secret masking and JSON output.
- [Encrypt](README.md#encrypting-secrets): Encrypt dotfile secrets to recipient age public keys, SSH keys, or identity key files.
- [Decrypt](README.md#ssh-key-encryption--decryption): Decrypt an age or sops encrypted secret dotfile to stdout or file.
- [Edit](README.md#editing-secrets): Decrypt, edit in temporary memory or editor, and re-encrypt age secret files safely.
- [Rekey](README.md#commands): Re-encrypt age secrets across packages with updated recipient public keys.
- [Completions](README.md#shell-completions): Generate dynamic or static shell completion scripts for Bash, Zsh, Fish, PowerShell, and Elvish.
- [Man](README.md#man-page): Output UNIX roff format man page to stdout.

## Build and Quality Gates

- [Cargo Manifest](Cargo.toml): Package configuration, dependencies (clap, age, walkdir, serde, tempfile, similar), and release profile definitions.
- [Taskfile Automation](Taskfile.yml): Standard tasks for cross-compiling, testing, clippy linting, formatting, coverage, and releases.
- [CI Pipeline](.github/workflows/ci.yml): GitHub Actions automated test, lint, and cross-platform verification matrix.
